name: Point of Collapse
detailed_description:
Point of Collapse is an RPG set in an alternate Russian Empire during the era of palace coups, when political instability sweeps across the country. The situation grows even more tense with the discovery of a new natural resource, ultimately leading to a civil war.

Your character is a false detective who ends up in a camp of fanatic magic worshippers. Only his status as a false detective allows him to avoid certain death. Explore the world, uncover secrets, and find your path.

A unique authorial world

Immerse yourself in a world with its own laws and customs, a world that is on the brink of collapse. You will find yourself on the outskirts of the empire, where power rules and the law doesn’t reach. Among criminals and adventurers, the drive to survive reigns supreme, while a civil war between the government and the rebels rages on.

Freedom of choice

There will be many challenges on your path, but each one can be solved in three ways: empathy, strength, or intelligence. You can use any of these methods or combine them; the choice is entirely yours. It’s important to remember that each approach can be effective in different situations, and the ability to adapt them to the specific circumstances can play a crucial role in your success.

Artistic style

The combination of a strict design style with artistic inserts for full immersion into the game world creates a unique atmosphere where every detail contributes to a deeper understanding of what’s happening. This approach not only enhances the visual experience but also helps players feel the emotions and motivations of the characters, making the gameplay more engaging and layered.

short_description: Point of Collapse is a story-driven RPG set in an alternate Russian Empire. You will take on the role of a false detective, caught in the heart of madness and intrigue in the deep Russian countryside. Choices will be made at every turn, and don't expect easy answers.
